entities.summary: Axel Krister Edward Leonard Jägerskiöld was a Finnish-born Swedish zoologist. He collected specimens across Scandinavia despite problems in vision and hearing and was a curator at the Gothenburg museum. His early work was on nematodes but later worked on birds and marine biology.

entities.summary: Axel Krister Edward Leonard Jägerskiöld was a Finnish-born Swedish zoologist. He collected specimens across Scandinavia despite problems in vision and hearing and was a curator at the Gothenburg museum. His early work was on nematodes but later worked on birds and marine biology.
